nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the farm name 'Farm AMONG NFT'.
Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the access-control guard for issueNFT.
Reference to the AufToken ERC20 contract used for staking transfers.
Reference to the AufNFT ERC721 contract used to mint reward tickets.
Array of addresses that have staked, iterated in issueNFT.
Mapping of staker address to staked balance; written after external calls in stakeTokens/unstakeTokens.
Mapping flagging whether an address has ever staked.
Mapping flagging whether an address currently has an active stake.
Constructor wiring aufToken, aufNFT and setting owner to msg.sender.
Stakes a fixed 1e22 AMONG amount: pulls tokens via transferFrom then updates stakingBalance, stakers, isStaking and hasStaked.
Withdraws the caller's staking balance via aufToken.transfer and afterwards resets stakingBalance and isStaking.
Owner-only function that loops over stakers and mints NFTs proportionally to their balance.
msg.sender used in the constructor to assign contract ownership.
msg.sender used as the staker key, array member and transferFrom source in stakeTokens.
msg.sender used as the balance key and transfer recipient in unstakeTokens.
msg.sender compared against owner as the access-control check in issueNFT.
External call aufToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) executed before any state update in stakeTokens.
External call aufToken.transfer(msg.sender, balance) executed before stakingBalance is reset in unstakeTokens.
External call aufNFT.mint(recipient) executed inside a nested loop in issueNFT.
Unchecked arithmetic stakingBalance[msg.sender] = stakingBalance[msg.sender] + _amount in Solidity 0.6 (no built-in overflow check).
Mapping of contracts allowed to mint NFTs, checked by the onlyAuthorized modifier.
Authorized mint entry point that assigns totalSupply()+1 as the new token id.
Internal ERC20 balance ledger written by _transfer.
ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _tokens).
ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens then decrements allowance.
Internal balance mutation routine used by both transfer and transferFrom.
Stake amount parameter constrained to exactly 10000000000000000000000.
Constructor parameter holding the AufToken address.
Constructor parameter holding the AufNFT address.
Local copy of the caller's staking balance read before the external transfer.
Loop local holding stakers[i] and used as the NFT mint target.
Local snapshot of stakingBalance[recipient] inside the issueNFT loop.
Number of NFTs derived as balance / 10000000000000000000000.
Outer loop index over the stakers array.
Inner loop index controlling how many times aufNFT.mint is invoked.

edges.reason: Deployer msg.sender invokes the constructor.
Constructor parameter _aufToken is assigned to the aufToken state variable.
Constructor parameter _aufNFT is assigned to the aufNFT state variable.
owner state variable is initialized from msg.sender.
msg.sender drives the staker identity inside stakeTokens.
_amount parameter is consumed by stakeTokens.
stakeTokens performs the external aufToken.transferFrom call.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument to transferFrom.
_amount is passed directly into transferFrom.
External call on aufToken resolves to AufToken.transferFrom.
The external token pull executes before the stakingBalance addition.
stakingBalance[msg.sender] is updated with an unchecked addition.
stakingBalance mapping is keyed by msg.sender.
stakers.push(msg.sender) appends the caller to the stakers array.
hasStaked mapping is keyed by msg.sender.
isStaking mapping is keyed by msg.sender.
msg.sender drives unstakeTokens logic and recipient selection.
stakingBalance[msg.sender] is read into the balance local.
The balance local is fetched for the msg.sender key.
unstakeTokens performs the external aufToken.transfer before resetting state.
External token transfer sends funds to msg.sender mid-execution, allowing a malicious caller contract to re-enter.
External call on aufToken resolves to AufToken.transfer.
stakingBalance[msg.sender] is zeroed only after the external transfer, violating checks-effects-interactions.
isStaking is set to false after the transfer completes.
msg.sender is the subject of the issueNFT caller check.
issueNFT reverts unless msg.sender equals owner.
issueNFT drives the nested mint loop over stakers and NFT amounts.
External call on aufNFT resolves to AufNFT.mint.
AufNFT.mint authorization is enforced through the authorized mapping.
recipient is read from the stakers array.
balance is read from stakingBalance[recipient].
NFTtokens is computed by dividing balance by 1e22.
Outer loop index i bounds the iteration over stakers.
Inner loop index j bounds the repeated aufNFT.mint calls.
recipient is used as the mint target argument inside issueNFT.
NFTtokens determines the number of inner loop iterations.
AufToken.transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
_balances storage is mutated by _transfer.
AufToken.transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance and mutates balances.

normalization_plan.reason: The fixed stake amount parameter only feeds the stakeTokens body and its external transferFrom call, so it collapses into the stakeTokens core function.
Constructor parameter solely assigned to the aufToken state variable inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter solely assigned to the aufNFT state variable inside the constructor.
Local balance snapshot exists only to serve the unstakeTokens transfer and reset sequence.
Loop-local recipient is only used as the mint target within issueNFT.
Local balance snapshot feeds the NFT amount computation inside issueNFT.
NFTtokens is a derived local that only bounds the issueNFT mint loop.
Outer loop counter is purely a control index of the issueNFT iteration.
Inner loop counter directly controls the number of aufNFT.mint unsafe external calls.
